item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 19,545 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-17T12:00:00Z Official contract: https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/notice/6dc1388e-b51b-42a8-b7e8-2320c31e37e5 Backup search: https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Search?searchTerm=CA18707%20-%20RFQ%202026/49%20-%20NMANDD%20PEACEPLUS%20Thriving%20Together%20-%20Celebrating%20Cultures%20and%20Diversity%20-%203.5%20Women%27s%20Festival

View on OpenTenders

Contract reference: ocds-b5fd17-0e6b4c08-05b7-4094-bdd2-028fabb769b0 Competent and creative suppliers are invited to tender for the design, development, and delivery of a two-stage Women's Festival. Stage 1 will deliver pre-festival workshops and a cross-border learning visit to build the confidence, skills and independence of women from diverse backgrounds. Activities will focus on practical life skills, wellbeing, leadership and personal development, with opportunities to build networks and learn from inspiring women and community organisations. Stage 2 will culminate in an Inclusive Women's Festival around International Women's Day 2027, celebrating participants' achievements through taster sessions, demonstrations, information stands and talks. The festival will showcase learning outcomes while encouraging attendees to access support, explore new interests and connect with local groups. To access this competition: Registered: Login to https://suppliers.multiquote.com and view the opportunity CA18707. View on OpenTenders

Contract reference: ocds-b5fd17-f6eaec71-f5dc-4128-a89a-43884330862e To deliver a reliable, free and easy-to-use public Wi-Fi network for Runswick Bay that improves the visitor experience and overall connectivity, provides useful visitor data, while respecting the character of the village and the special qualities of the National Park. The following outputs are mandatory requirements for this brief: 1: A fully installed and operational network by June 2027. 2: Free, legally compliant access (Digital Economy Act 2010, content filtering, UK GDPR). 3: Remote monitoring, maintenance and support for the three-year term. 4: Visitor analytics reporting. The contract will run for three years from the date the network is fully installed and operational.

item.title: CA18691 - RFQ 2026/48 - PEACEPLUS Roots Relationships Programme - Slieve Gullion DEA
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 10,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-15T12:00:00Z Official contract: https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/notice/91ce9ffa-4f4e-4f2c-826c-070b55e93f87 Backup search: https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Search?searchTerm=CA18691%20-%20RFQ%202026/48%20-%20PEACEPLUS%20Roots%20Relationships%20Programme%20-%20Slieve%20Gullion%20DEA

View on OpenTenders

Contract reference: ocds-b5fd17-2c4ff32f-7c74-4afb-a215-0ddbb969af2d To deliver a community-led Arts, Crafts and Heritage Capacity Building Programme in the Slieve Gullion DEA, working with community groups from the Forkhill and Newtownhamilton areas. The programme should use arts, crafts, cultural heritage and creative skills development as a vehicle for building organisational capacity, increasing skills and confidence, supporting knowledge exchange, and creating opportunities for participants to learn from one another through practical activities, shared experiences and networking opportunities. The programme should celebrate and explore the rich cultural and heritage assets of the area while creating opportunities for participants from different backgrounds to connect, collaborate and develop lasting relationships. Through shared learning and creative engagement, participants will strengthen both their individual skills and the sustainability of their community organisations. This project will serve as both a community development initiative and a peacebuilding mechanism, creating sustained and meaningful contact across communities while strengthening local organisations and promoting appreciation of the area's diverse cultural heritage. To access this competition: Registered: Login to https://suppliers.multiquote.com and view the opportunity CA18691. Not registered: Visit https://suppliers.multiquote.com then register and quote CA18691 as the reason for registration. Any queries please contact MultiQuote on 020 3920 8054.
